notes.title: It Consumes at Boomstock 2025
notes.content: [p]It Consumes will be taking part in this year’s edition of Boomstock, a festival and showcase dedicated to first-person shooters. [/p][p][/p][p]The event takes place from September 23-27, and It Consumes will be part of the video showcase on the opening day with a new trailer and announcement. If you’re a fan of classic FPS games, then make sure to check out the event! notes.title: It Consumes is part of TGAGWCAGA 2024!
notes.content:
I'm happy to share that It Consumes will be part of TGAGWCAGA 2024, or [i]The Game Awards for Games Who Can't Afford the Game Awards[/i] - a brand new indie game showcase streaming this Friday, December 13th!

TGAGWCAGA is a showcase designed to spotlight indie games that truly deserve more attention—while also poking a bit of fun at the exclusivity of The Game Awards.

Subscribe to TGAGWCAGA's Youtube channel to watch!

TGAGWCAGA 2024
Friday, December 13th 
5:00 PM UTC / 6:00 PM CET / 12:00 PM ET
Watch the stream here: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@TGAGWCAGA]https://www.youtube.com/@TGAGWCAGA[/url]

It Consumes will also be part of the Steam Event running from December 13th to December 22nd, featuring tons of other awesome indie games.

Make sure to check it out this Friday, tell your friends, and wishlist some new games!

notes.title: It Consumes joins Bullet Heaven Festival 2.0 with a new demo
notes.content:
[h3]BULLET HEAVEN FEST 2.0[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43898717/44e94238fdf17cfbfce6f9aaa85e856a68c742fa.png[/img]

It Consumes is taking part in this year's edition of the Bullet Heaven Festival, which starts today!

To celebrate the event, an updated demo is now live. It includes several new perks, upgrades, and abilities, and it also adds the game's first boss.

I'd love to hear your feedback, so join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/KJb3VKxRtM]Discord[/url] if you haven't already and let me know what you think.

Now go check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/bulletheaven2]festival[/url] and play some demos!

notes.title: Join the It Consumes community on Discord
notes.content:
The official Discord server for It Consumes is now live. Come be a part of the community and share your thoughts on the game. 

As a solo developer, I'm very eager to hear everyone's feedback. Are there some things you disliked about the demo? Come let me know. Have some ideas or suggestions? Share those too! Incorporating the community's feedback will be a key component of the game's development, so everyone who plays is welcome to jump in the server and be a part of it. 

Server link: https://discord.gg/nfeEJjwhS5

notes.title: Demo is now live!
notes.content: A small demo version of the game is now available for everyone. It's fairly limited in scope at the moment, mostly just giving you a sense of what the basic combat is like. But the demo will be continuously updated as development of the game continues, so check back in every once in a while to see what new content/features have been added.

notes.title: Where to stay up to date on the development of It Consumes
notes.content:
Interested in following along with the development of the game? Here are all the accounts where I will be posting updates. TikTok will be posted to the most frequently, usually with much shorter snippets of new things added to the game. And YouTube will be much less frequent, most likely only getting new videos posted at major development milestones. 

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@chrisparbery 

Twitter: https://twitter.com/chrisparbery 

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@chrisparbery 

And don't forget you can also follow on Steam! When the public demo is live I will be posting patch notes and commenting on changes right here on Steam. So to stay up to date on all that the best way is to hit the follow button on the It Consumes store page.
